specs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide landscape game background, richly detailed cinematic realistic fantasy interior, 3:2 or 16:9 composition. A cozy family living room belonging to a benevolent creator god. Warm walnut wood, cream stone fireplace softly glowing on left, layered Persian rug, deep teal curtains, books, brass astrolabe, a few floating tiny golden stars and wisps of stardust, starry dusk sky and a crescent moon visible through tall arched windows at right. Subtle astronomical carvings and golden constellation inlays, inviting warm amber lamplight mixed with mysterious blue celestial light. Domestic, lived-in, loving family home, not a temple. Large central wall/work area kept relatively calm with warm dark teal plaster and carved wooden trim so a game collection cabinet or transparent tank UI can be overlaid. Detailed objects and props mostly along left/right margins and bottom. No people, no text, no UI, no shelf slots, no embedded tank. Premium fantasy game environment, photographic materials, dreamy but believable.

Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: production game sprite atlas, a single square image with EXACTLY 4 columns and 4 rows, 16 equal cells. Each cell contains ONE independent photorealistic cut-out object, completely isolated on true transparent alpha background. The cell center positions are exactly 12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5% of width and height. Fit every object within the middle 76% of its cell, leaving generous transparent gutters; nothing may cross cells. No captions, no text, no grid lines, no frames, no circles, no pedestals, no contact shadows outside the object. Front/side view appropriate to a 2D physics game, crisp solid silhouette, fine natural physical material texture, realistic photographic studio lighting from upper left. Actual realistic objects, NOT emoji, NOT icons, NOT cartoon, NOT low-poly, NOT plastic toys. Magical things should look like photorealistic cinema creatures/materials. The output must have alpha transparency. Read row-major order EXACTLY as follows: ROW 1: (1) compact bright orange flame with a solid clear silhouette (2) large blue translucent water droplet (3) curled white vapor knot shaped like a compact airy spiral (4) small irregular chunk of brown soil with moss on top. ROW 2: (5) fluffy compact white cloud (6) compact pale teal swirling wind vortex (7) dark gray cloud with three large raindrops directly beneath it (8) dense white steam plume. ROW 3: (9) glowing red-orange lava rock (10) irregular gray granite rock (11) small fiery golden sun sphere without long rays (12) solid bright yellow lightning bolt. ROW 4: (13) small green leafy plant with roots (14) brown wet mud clump (15) compact brilliant rainbow arch (16) luminous green seed of life with two tiny leaves.
